Container.Name: stockportfolio
Container.Overview: Portfolio management with market data, valuation, charts and tolerance-band rebalancing in your browser. Quotes, asset types and price history come from a separate StockInfo API. Trade plans are simulations; no orders are placed.[br][br]The StockPortfolio API keeps accounts, sessions and private portfolios in the persistent /data directory. On first start, read the one-time setup code from the container log and create the first admin in the browser. Each account, including another admin, has its own portfolios; the same account loads them in another browser. Export individual backups under Settings - Backup and back up /data. Old browser portfolios require an explicit one-time import by the setup account. Keep the /data mapping stable when updating.[br][br]Set STOCKINFO_API_URL to an address reachable from your browser. StockInfo must allow the web app origin through CORS. HTTPS pages require an HTTPS API. For HTTPS behind a reverse proxy, set the exact public origin and enable secure cookies. Behind a reverse proxy, the live update stream must not be buffered; nginx-based proxies handle this automatically.[br][br]The container serves the web app and account API on port 8080 without root privileges. Older images used port 80: update existing port mappings when upgrading.
Container.Requires: A StockInfo API reachable from the browser.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app. The container listens on 8080. Keep the host address and port stable to retain the browser storage origin.

Config.Name: StockInfo API
Config.Description: URL of your StockInfo API, reachable from the browser (for example https://stockinfo.example.com). Required; no built-in public API. Restart the container after changing it.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite data for StockPortfolio accounts, sessions and private portfolios. Back up this directory and keep the mapping during updates.

Config.Name: Public origin
Config.Description: Exact browser origin, including scheme and port, when using a reverse proxy (for example https://portfolio.example.com).

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set true when the app is served over HTTPS; required behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for container logs, for example Europe/Vienna. The web interface follows the browser timezone.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. The container prepares /data for this user on start. Default 99 (nobody); must not be 0.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Default 100 (users); must not be 0.
